name: reviewer
description: Evaluation suite for the reviewer runtime skill in Portfolio Copilot.

parts.text: Review proposed buy of 100 shares of VTI at $250 within IPS bounds. Current allocation is under target.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=true, all five rule_results.passed=true, requires_human_approval based on IPS thresholds only.
Review proposed buy of TSLA where TSLA is in constraints.excluded_tickers.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=false, rule 'excluded_ticker' passed=false with detail explaining TSLA is excluded. requires_human_approval=true.
Review proposed buy of XOM where Energy is in constraints.excluded_sectors.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=false, rule 'excluded_sector' passed=false with detail explaining XOM is in excluded sector Energy. requires_human_approval=true.
Review proposed buy of AAPL that would increase AAPL position to 35% of total portfolio value when concentration_limit_percent is 20%.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=false, rule 'concentration_limit' passed=false with detail explaining resulting position exceeds 20% limit. requires_human_approval=true.
Review proposed buy of an Equity ticker when Equity asset class is already over-allocated at 75% against a max_percent of 70%.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=false, rule 'allocation_band_direction' passed=false with detail explaining trade moves asset class further over maximum band. requires_human_approval=true.
Review proposed trade referencing IPS version 1 when currently active IPS version is 2.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=false, rule 'ips_version_current' passed=false with detail explaining stale IPS reference. requires_human_approval=true.
Review proposed buy of VTI of $50,000 where all rules pass, but estimated_value_usd exceeds approval_required_above_usd threshold of $25,000.
Returns ReviewerVerdict with overall_pass=true, all rule_results.passed=true, but requires_human_approval=true because trade value exceeds high-stakes threshold.
